metadata.description: Agents, skills and rules for this house's stack.

plugins.name: tc96-core
plugins.description: Testing and HTTP contract, the delivery flow in four phases, and the roles that cross any stack. Always enable.

plugins.name: tc96-frontend
plugins.description: React, TanStack Router and Query, React Hook Form and Storybook in this house's stack — writing, structure and review of interfaces. Enable in a project with a frontend.

plugins.name: tc96-backend
plugins.description: Bun runtime, Elysia and Drizzle — HTTP service, persistence and dependencies. Enable in a project with a backend.

plugins.name: tc96-tailwind
plugins.description: Tailwind CSS v4: setup, migration, build, variant split and review skills, each with its own normative docs (TW-*). Self-contained: enable alone or with tc96-frontend.

plugins.name: tc96-design-docs
plugins.description: Writing-only document skills: PRD, ADR, epic, feature, story, tasks, bug, spec and PR, each with its template and model tier, and the doc-writer agents that run them in a fresh context with no search or shell. Self-contained: enable with tc96-core or alone.

plugins.name: tc96-e2e
plugins.description: Playwright — writing, auditing and diagnosing E2E tests. Enable in a project with an E2E suite.
